lines.text: Accountant… two years of experience. Sales… three years of experience. Seriously? How can I get experience if nobody gives me a job?
Can I come in? You've been in front of that laptop for five hours.
I'm looking for a job, Lina. And all these ads want experience and excellent English.
Let me see… "Customer Service Agents. Full-time. Good salary. Training provided. Fresh graduates are welcome." Fresh graduates! That's you!
A call center? Hmm… Sami works in a call center.
So call him!
Hello? Adam! What's up, graduate?
Sami, I found a job ad for a call center. Is the job difficult?
Not really. You talk to customers on the phone and help them solve problems. But the most important thing is your English. You need to listen well and speak clearly.
My English is… OK. I think.
Just apply. What can you lose?
Name: Adam Fares. Degree: Bachelor of Commerce. Skills: computers, teamwork… Experience… nothing.
Write about your university project! And the summer you helped Uncle in his shop.
You're right. OK… upload my CV… and… Apply. Done!
Hello, is this Adam Fares?
Yes, speaking.
I'm calling from the HR department at BlueLine Communications. We'd like to invite you for an interview next Sunday at ten a.m.
Really? Yes! Of course! Thank you!
You're welcome. See you on Sunday.
Well? Well?
I have an interview!
Yes! Wait… are you ready?
…I have no idea.

choice.q: What do most job ads want?
Who works in a call center?

options: ask for a job in an official way

questions.q: What do most of the job ads want?
questions.a: They want experience and excellent English.
She finds a job ad for fresh graduates and helps him with his CV.

questions.q: What does Sami say is the most important thing in a call center?
questions.a: English. You need to listen well and speak clearly.

questions.q: What does Adam write in the experience part of his CV?
questions.a: His university project and the summer he helped his uncle in his shop.

questions.q: Who calls Adam three days later, and why?
questions.a: A woman from the HR department. She invites him for an interview.

questions.q: What kind of job do you want? Why?
questions.a: Example: I want to work in a bank because I like numbers.
